description: Image Text Editor is an AI-powered online tool for editing and replacing text directly inside existing images. Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP image, select the text you want to change, enter new content, and generate an updated version while preserving the original font style, color, position, layout, and surrounding background as closely as possible.
